import numpy as np, json
y = np.load(WORK/'y.npy'); BL = np.load(WORK/'base_logits.npy'); bp = BL.argmax(1); folds = np.load(WORK/'folds.npy')
def f1macro(y, p, K=4):
    f=[]
    for k in range(K):
        tp=((p==k)&(y==k)).sum(); fp=((p==k)&(y!=k)).sum(); fn=((p!=k)&(y==k)).sum()
        f.append(2*tp/max(2*tp+fp+fn,1))
    return np.mean(f)
def ridge_fit(X, T, lam, std=True):
    mu = X.mean(0); sd = (X.std(0)+1e-6) if std else np.ones(X.shape[1])
    A = np.c_[(X-mu)/sd, np.ones(len(X))]
    R = lam*np.eye(A.shape[1]); R[-1,-1]=0
    Wr = np.linalg.solve(A.T@A+R, A.T@T)
    # return as affine map: T = X @ M + c
    M = Wr[:-1]/sd[:,None]; c = Wr[-1] - mu@M
    return M, c
def ridge_cv(X, T, lam, folds, std=True):
    out = np.zeros((len(X), T.shape[1]))
    for f in range(5):
        tr, te = folds!=f, folds==f
        M,c = ridge_fit(X[tr], T[tr], lam, std)
        out[te] = X[te]@M + c
    return out
def report(name, lg):
    p = lg.argmax(1)
    print(f"{name}: agr {np.mean(p==bp):.3f} acc {np.mean(p==y):.3f} F1 {f1macro(y,p):.3f}")
'''

def gelu(x): return 0.5*x*(1+erf(x/np.sqrt(2)))

def build_layer(Lr, m, lam_rel, extra_A=None, score='var'):
    pre = f"roberta.encoder.layer.{Lr}."
    W1 = base(pre+"intermediate.dense.weight"); b1 = base(pre+"intermediate.dense.bias")
    W2 = base(pre+"output.dense.weight"); b2 = base(pre+"output.dense.bias")
    A = ffn_data(Lr) if extra_A is None else extra_A
    H = gelu(A@W1.T + b1)
